label_evidence: Amiodarone increases digoxin concentration; the label recommends reducing digoxin by half or discontinuing it and monitoring for toxicity.
Amiodarone potentiates anticoagulant response and can result in serious or fatal bleeding; dose reduction and close INR monitoring are recommended.
Amiodarone increases plasma concentration of HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors including atorvastatin; a lower starting dose may be required.
Amiodarone may increase carvedilol levels, potentially causing further slowing of heart rate or cardiac conduction.
Concomitant use can increase the risk of bradycardia; digoxin concentrations increase by about 15%, so increased monitoring is recommended.
